data.name: Fangjie:Shattered Altars
data.detailed_description:
Explore a day-night, terrain-and-biome-generating voxel wilderness — in Fangjie: Shattered Altars, you play an adventurer set on restoring order, searching the shattered world for its lost altars.

KEY FEATURES

  • Procedurally generated open world: terrain, biomes, and encounters recombine every run, so there's no fixed path.

  • 4 races × 5 classes: choose from four races with distinct strengths — Human, Elf, Orc, and Undead — paired with five combat classes including Warrior, plus a freely allocated skill tree to build your own playstyle.

  • Action combat: melee, ranged, and spellcasting all keep a hands-on feel, with clear differences between classes.

  • Solo or co-op: get comfortable with the world alone, or bring friends along to explore, fight, and find altars together.

CURRENT STATE

Fangjie is still in active development, but the main story is playable from start to finish, including all of its endings. We're still polishing the open-ended progression system that continues past the story, multiplayer synchronization for quest and story progress, and combat balance across the full level range. We're being upfront about where things stand, and we want players to help shape Fangjie into a complete world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U 或 AMD Ryzen 3 3200U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 支援 WebGPU 的內顯（相當於 Intel UHD 620 等級）
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12代 或 AMD Ryzen 5 5600（六核以上）
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 獨立顯卡 GTX 1650 或更好
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 12
  • Processor: Apple Silicon 或 Intel Core i5（2018 年後機型）
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 13
  • Processor: Apple M1 或更新
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 或更新的內顯
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U 或 AMD Ryzen 3 3200U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 支援 WebGPU 的內顯（相當於 Intel UHD 620 等級）
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12代 或 AMD Ryzen 5 5600（六核以上）
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 獨立顯卡 GTX 1650 或更好
